Scope of Work includes design, supply, installation, commissioning, and demonstration of Ethylene Oligom erization Reactor System along with accessories at HP Green R&D Centre, Bengaluru from a single source supplier. For detailed Scope refer, Annexures, Scope of work and technical specification, Notes to vend or, AMC contract are attached in ‘Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC’. Line No. 01 is for Supply & Line items 02 to 04 are for AMC. (Annual Maintenance Contract) which shall co mmence after completion of Guarantee / Warranty period of the supplied item. AMC LINE ITEMS (LINE ITEMS 02 TO 04) ================================== ANNUAL MAINTENANCE CONTRACT (AMC)– 1ST, 2nd & 3rd YEAR. o AMC shall be applicable for (Three 3 years) after the completion of Guarantee period. o AMC shall include two (2) preventive maintenance visits per year. o The AMC price covers two (2) scheduled Preventive Maintenance (PM) visits and all necessary breakdown s upport on as-and-when-required basis during the contract period. No additional service or visit charges sh all be payable for breakdown visits separately. o Vendor shall provide breakdown Visit within 72 hours of receiving intimation from HPCL. For detailed Scope refer, Annexures, Scope of work and technical specification, Notes to vend or, AMC contract are attached in ‘Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC’. Guarantee/warranty certificate shall be submitted along with the dispatch documents. Vendor shall submit ABG towards the advance payment milestone.

“This milestone payment will be processed against submission of Proforma Invoice and documents as men tioned above. ABG shall be as per HPCL’s Format. The Vendor shall furnish all original documentation in accordance with the tender requirements applicable to each milestone payment. Payment shall be done within 30 days of completion of each milestone as above and invoice submission.
